purpose: An independently frozen capability track for integrated image input. It does not change the v1 100-point base score or the 20-point context and multi-request bonuses.

interface.request_format: OpenAI chat content parts with one data:image/png;base64 image_url followed by one text part
interface.supported_rule: A service that reports multimodal=true must execute the image requests through the submitted ApxInf implementation without fallback.
interface.unsupported_rule: A service that reports multimodal=false remains eligible for the text leaderboard, but an image probe must fail closed with HTTP 400, 415, 422, or 501 and error.type=unsupported_capability. HTTP 200, HTTP 500, ignoring the image, or silently delegating to another backend is invalid.

public_suite.release_rule: The generator, seed, prompts, images, exact answers, and manifest are public.

hidden_suite.release_rule: The generator shape is public; the seed, generated PNG files, prompts, exact answers, and manifest stay teacher-only and are frozen before the course opens.

normalization: Take choices[0].message.content, discard at most one leading <think>...</think> block when present, and strip surrounding ASCII whitespace. The remaining text must exactly equal the case answer.

badges.multimodal-ready: All 4 public and all 8 hidden cases pass, every request succeeds, the service remains healthy, multimodal=true is declared, and no fallback is active.
badges.declared-unsupported: multimodal=false and the required fail-closed probe passes. This is a valid text-only submission, not a multimodal pass.

scoring.policy: This v1 track publishes a capability badge and diagnostics only. Promoting it to points requires a new leaderboard contract and a newly frozen cohort; it cannot be added retroactively to an active round.
diagnostic_metrics: peak VRAM when supplied by the teacher harness
